_note: OpenClaw config example (sanitized). Mirror the three-tier dispatch + fallback + skill-allowlist patterns in your own openclaw.json. Replace every placeholder before use. No real hosts, ports, tokens, or business paths appear here.

cloud._note: Cloud model for L1 decision agent (strong semantics). Use your own provider + API key via auth, never commit a key.

local-primary._note: Host node: multiple resident models behind llama-swap.

local-gpu._note: Secondary GPU node, one model resident at a time.

defaults._note: Fallback chain: cloud drops -> host 30B -> host 8B. Offline-safe.
defaults._note2: Skill allowlist is per-agent (below). Set tools.profile minimal for small-ctx agents and re-add duties via tools.alsoAllow.
defaults._note3: Throttle bootstrap doc injection for agents with a small context window.

list._note: L1 decision agent: cloud model, sees NO skills (keeps its own context lean).
L2 dispatch agent: local 8B, no skill injection.
L2 aggregator agent: local 8B, no skill injection.
L3 execution agent: heavy work on GPU 14B, allowlisted skills only.
list._note2: agentToAgent allowlist governs main <-> dispatch <-> execution handoff (not shown here).
